caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered against a plain, light beige background. The object is a cowbell, with a trapezoidal shape that is wider at the bottom and tapers toward the top. It has a dark, somewhat textured surface rendered in shades of brown, gray, and touches of green. At the top of the cowbell, there is a simple rectangular loop handle colored in brown. The lines and shading suggest volume and shadow, with the left side of the cowbell in moderate shadow and the right side slightly lighter. Subtle pencil notations and some faded handwritten text appear at the bottom left and right of the image, but they do not interact with the main object. The composition is simple, focusing attention entirely on the cowbell.
title: Cow Bell
